name: autonomous-board
description: Read-only board of an autonomous-run task: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN waves and slices and TASK_STATE phases as to-do, in-progress, escalated, proposed, done columns. Use when you want a single-glance status of an autonomous run. Do not use to change state (use sync-task-state), to assess a multi-slice task (use where-we-at), or to route next (use what-next).
